response.query: Which economic-significance metrics (market-cap change, implied cost-of-capital shifts) will we pre-specify to translate CARs into policy-relevant quantities?
response.answer: To translate CARs into policy-relevant quantities, we pre-specify market-cap change and implied cost-of-capital shifts as economic-significance metrics. These metrics directly impact investment valuation and risk assessment.
